_meta.name: English
_meta.note: Source locale. Every other file is a translation of this one; keys here are the canonical set.

status.paused: paused — ingest stopped, brain still queryable
pin.not_found: no repository named %1$s under the clone root
pin.branch_guess: branch not given — using the remote default, %1$s
ingest.skip_bulk: skipped — a bulk ingest is already running
ingest.skip_build: skipped — a build is using the machine
ingest.skip_model_down: skipped — the model is not loaded
ingest.lock_held: another run holds the bank lock — waiting %1$ss
ingest.extractions_failed: %1$s extractions failed — not counting this pass as clean
ingest.extractions_pending: %1$s extractions still running at the drain timeout — not counting this pass as clean
throttle.to_reduced: a build started — dropping the model to %1$s slots
throttle.to_full: the machine is idle — taking the model back to %1$s slots
watchdog.model_down: the model is not responding — reloading it
watchdog.model_wedged: the model is wedged: healthy, work queued, no progress — reloading it
error.daemon_unreachable: cannot reach the memory daemon at %1$s
error.config_missing: no configuration at %1$s — run install.sh first
error.org_unset: set ORG in %1$s before ingesting pull requests
